Who are we?

Africa Global Press: Your trusted source for news about Africa

All of Africa, All the News.

Africa Global Press brings you comprehensive and unbiased coverage of Africa.

From politics to culture, economics to sports, African voices, local perspectives, authentic information. Dive into the heart of African news with the latest news, key events, and exclusive analysis on Africa Global Press. Stay informed 24/7.

Our Mission: To Inform, To Enlighten, To Inspire

  • Inform : Providing comprehensive coverage of African news, emphasizing accuracy, objectivity, and impartiality. We cover the political, economic, social, and cultural events shaping the continent.
  • Enlighten : Providing in-depth analysis and nuanced perspectives to help our readers understand the complex issues facing Africa. We encourage critical thinking and constructive debate.
  • Inspire : Highlighting the successes, innovations, and positive initiatives emerging from the African continent. We want to celebrate the creativity, resilience, and ingenuity of Africans.
  • Defend press freedom, a freedom that is in decline in many regions. We strongly believe that journalists must be able to work safely.
  • Provide an opportunity for African journalists to tell their stories and share their knowledge from their own perspective

Our Values: Integrity, Independence, Commitment

  • Integrity : We adhere to the highest journalistic standards of accuracy, fairness, and ethics. We are committed to verifying our sources and correcting any errors promptly and transparently.
  • Independence : We are financially and politically independent. We are not affiliated with any political party, government, or interest group. Our sole objective is to serve our readers by providing reliable and unbiased information.
  • Commitment : We are deeply committed to the African continent and its people. We believe in the power of information to promote development, social justice, and democracy.
  • Diversity : We believe it takes different voices to tell a story, so we try to hire writers from different backgrounds so everyone feels comfortable sharing their stories.

Frequently asked questions

Africa Global Press is an online news outlet dedicated to news from the African continent: politics, economy, society, culture, sports, science and technology.

Integrity, independence, commitment and diversity: the newsroom verifies its sources, corrects errors promptly and is not affiliated with any party, government or interest group.

Use the form on the Contact page to write to the newsroom, and the "Subscribe to our Newsletter" button to receive African news in your inbox.
